surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 4 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Quraish (Quraysh) is the 106th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 4 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ لِإِيلَافِ قُرَيْشٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم لايلاف قريش
ayahs.translation_saheeh: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [He did this] to make the Quraysh feel secure

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: secure in their winter and summer journeys

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Let them worship the Lord of this House
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So let them worship the Lord of this House

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعࣲ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنۡ خَوۡفِۭ
ayahs.arabic_simple: الَّذِي أَطْعَمَهُمْ مِنْ جُوعٍ وَآمَنَهُمْ مِنْ خَوْفٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الذي اطعمهم من جوع وامنهم من خوف
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who provides them with food to ward off hunger, safety to ward off fear
